13	/-!
14	# The sheaf half of the `ℙ¹` output bridge
15	
16	`AlgebraicGeometry.Adelic.P1PushforwardLocalFreenessBridge`
17	(`Picard/RigidPushforwardGate.lean` §2) upgrades the module-level conclusion of
18	the `ℙ¹` Čech engine — the base-linear differential `d` surjective, `H⁰ = ker d`
19	finite projective over `Γ(Spec A, ⊤)`, and `H⁰` compatible with arbitrary base
20	change — to the *sheaf* statement that `p_* M` is locally free of rank
21	`p.fiberH0 M t` near every `t : Spec A`.
22	
23	This file supplies the **sheaf** half of that upgrade, i.e. everything except
24	the rank identification:
25	
26	* `AlgebraicGeometry.specAwayToSpec_opensRange` — the open range of the
27	  localisation morphism `Spec R_f ⟶ Spec R` is the basic open `D(f)`.
28	* `AlgebraicGeometry.module_free_gamma_pullback_specAwayToSpec` — semilinear
29	  transport of freeness: if `Γ(Spec R, N)` becomes free of rank `r` after
30	  localising at the powers of `f`, then the sections of the pullback of a
31	  quasi-coherent `N` along `specAwayToSpec f` are free of rank `r` over
32	  `Localization.Away f`.
33	* `AlgebraicGeometry.exists_free_restrict_of_finite_projective_sections` — the
34	  crux: a quasi-coherent module on `Spec R` whose global sections are finite
35	  projective is free on a basic open neighbourhood of any prime, with the
36	  free rank read off as `Module.rankAtStalk` at that prime.
37	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Adelic.pushforwardTop_linearEquiv_ker` — the identification
38	  `Γ(Spec A, p_* M) ≃ₗ[Γ(Spec A, ⊤)] ker d`, together with its `Module.Finite`
39	  and `Module.Projective` corollaries.
40	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Adelic.p1PushforwardLocalFreenessBridge_of_rank` — the
41	  conditional assembly: the bridge `Prop` follows from the above once the
42	  pointwise rank of `Γ(Spec A, p_* M)` is known to be `p.fiberH0 M t`.  The rank
43	  hypothesis is a fibre-chart base-change comparison and is *not* proved here.
44	
45	Mathematically nothing new happens: the content is Stacks 00NX ("finite
46	projective is locally free"), Stacks 01HV/01I8 (the affine structure theorem,
47	already in the tree as `qcoh_iso_tilde_sections`) and the sheaf-condition
48	identification `Γ(X, M) ≅ ker d` of the two-chart Čech complex.
49	
50	Sources: Stacks 00NX, 00NV, 01HV, 01I8, 01XJ; Mumford, *Abelian Varieties*,
51	II §5; EGA III 7.9.9; Hartshorne III 12.11; Kleiman, *The Picard scheme*
52	(FGA Explained), §5.
53	-/
